mapper.sql: id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, runtime_profile_uuid, provider_kind, resource_type, oma_external_id, remote_id, parent_oma_external_id, resource_role, state, summary, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO runtime_resource_bindings ( organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, runtime_profile_uuid, provider_kind, resource_type, oma_external_id, remote_id, parent_oma_external_id, resource_role, state, summary, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.RuntimeProfileUUID}, #{params.ProviderKind}, #{params.ResourceType}, #{params.OMAExternalID}, #{params.RemoteID}, #{params.ParentOMAExternalID}, #{params.ResourceRole}, #{params.State}, CAST(#{params.Summary} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.UpdatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, resource_type, oma_external_id) DO UPDATE SET remote_id = EXCLUDED.remote_id, parent_oma_external_id = EXCLUDED.parent_oma_external_id, resource_role = EXCLUDED.resource_role, state = EXCLUDED.state, summary = EXCLUDED.summary, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING

INSERT INTO runtime_resource_bindings ( organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, runtime_profile_uuid, provider_kind, resource_type, oma_external_id, remote_id, parent_oma_external_id, resource_role, state, summary, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.RuntimeProfileUUID}, #{params.ProviderKind}, #{params.ResourceType}, #{params.OMAExternalID}, #{params.RemoteID}, #{params.ParentOMAExternalID}, #{params.ResourceRole}, #{params.State}, CAST(#{params.Summary} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.UpdatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT to_char(s.created_at AT TIME ZONE #{query.Timezone}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.summary->>'agent_id', ''), s.parent_oma_external_id, '') AS agent_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.summary->>'agent_name', ''), NULLIF(s.summary->>'agent_id', ''), s.parent_oma_external_id, '') AS agent_name, COUNT(*) AS session_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.summary->>'failed' = 'true' OR s.summary->>'status' IN ('failed', 'error')) AS failed_session_count, MAX(s.created_at) AS last_run_at FROM runtime_resource_bindings s WHERE s.organization_uuid = #{query.OrganizationUUID} AND s.workspace_uuid = #{query.WorkspaceUUID} AND s.resource_type = 'session' AND s.state != 'deleted' AND s.created_at >= #{query.Start} AND s.created_at < #{query.End} GROUP BY date, agent_id, agent_name ORDER BY date, agent_id
